title: Lively Dense Ethiopian Chicken Liver Tibs
description: A dense and earthy Ethiopian dish featuring chicken liver, render-fat, and vegetarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for kids and adults alike, this tibs recipe is a flavorful and nutritious meal option.

ingredients.name: chicken liver
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken liver and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the render-fat, stirring to combine.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the tibs hot.
Serve the tibs with injera bread or over rice.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
